gloss: as before; as previously; same as before

definitions.gloss: as before; as previously; same as before
definitions.explanation: Indicates that something continues or should continue in the same manner as it was before a change or event. Slightly more formal than 今まで通り.

examples.japanese: {以前|いぜん}{通|どお}り{続|つづ}けてください。
{病気|びょうき}の{後|あと}も{以前|いぜん}{通|どお}りの{生活|せいかつ}に{戻|もど}れた。
examples.english: After the illness, I was able to return to my life as before.

examples.japanese: {改装|かいそう}{工事|こうじ}{中|ちゅう}ですが、{営業|えいぎょう}は{以前|いぜん}{通|どお}り{行|おこな}っております。
examples.english: We are under renovation, but business is operating as before.

notes:
A combination of {以前|いぜん} (before, previously) and {通|どお}り (as, in accordance with). Used to indicate that something continues or should continue in the same way as it was before a change or event. Slightly more formal than {今|いま}まで{通|どお}り.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {以前|いぜん}{通|どお}り + verb: to do something as before
- {以前|いぜん}{通|どお}りの + noun: the same ~ as before
- {以前|いぜん}{通|どお}りに: in the same manner as before

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {今|いま}まで{通|どお}り — as usual; as before (more everyday/casual)
- {従来|じゅうらい}{通|どお}り — as conventionally done; as has been the case (more formal/institutional)
- {相変|あいか}わらず — as always; same as ever (can imply mild exasperation)
